about.title: About Henrico County Public Schools
about.content: Henrico County Public Schools serves Henrico County independently from Richmond Public Schools. Because some Henrico addresses use 'Richmond, VA' as the mailing city, families should use the HCPS School Locator to confirm the division and assigned schools for a street address.

about.title: What to Expect in the First School Year
about.content: HCPS calendars may assign different opening dates by grade level. Pre-K and kindergarten group assignments can also vary by elementary school. Families should use the selected school year's calendar and their school's published opening plan rather than assuming one date applies to every student. Specialty-center and regional-program timelines vary by program and year; check the current HCPS application information before making plans.

districtFaqs.q: Is Henrico County Public Schools the same as Richmond Public Schools?
districtFaqs.a: No. HCPS serves Henrico County, while Richmond Public Schools serves the City of Richmond. The two divisions publish separate calendars and use separate attendance boundaries.

districtFaqs.q: Why does my Henrico County address say 'Richmond, VA'?
districtFaqs.a: A mailing city does not necessarily match a local government or school-division boundary. Some Henrico County addresses use 'Richmond, VA,' but school assignment is based on the street address and HCPS attendance zones.

districtFaqs.q: How do I find my child's assigned school in Henrico County?
districtFaqs.a: Enter the street address in the official HCPS School Locator. It identifies the zoned elementary, middle, and high schools; the mailing city or ZIP code alone is not enough.

districtFaqs.q: When do HCPS specialty-program applications close?
districtFaqs.a: Application dates vary by program and school year. HCPS may publish separate timelines or later application windows for programs with available seats, so use the current program page rather than assuming one districtwide deadline.

districtFaqs.q: What documents are needed to enroll in HCPS?
districtFaqs.a: Families generally need an original state-issued birth certificate, residency documentation, a parent or guardian picture ID, and current immunization records. A physical exam form applies to grades K–5, and other documents may apply to an individual student's situation. Check the current HCPS enrollment instructions for the complete list.
